integrity: The proof is symbolic. The norm-one separating functional is checked directly on the actual generating set of the renormed space, and the symmetric conclusion uses the source's proved isometric embedding. No finite computation is used as a substitute for the universal slice statement.
scientific_limitations: The diameter statement concerns the explicit exposing functionals and the degree-two symmetric transfer in the cited construction. It does not classify all exposing functionals, higher-degree transfers, or arbitrary projective tensor products.
title: Full-diameter exposing slices for the non-elementary projective and symmetric tensors
